verdict.rationale: The Division publishes the corporate annual report and franchise tax deadline (on or before March 1) with an exact penalty of $200.00 plus 1.5% interest per month on tax and penalty. It also gives exact figures for the alternative-entity tax ($400 due June 1) and the quarterly estimated-tax schedule (40% by June 1, 20% by September 1, 20% by December 1, remainder by March 1). Missing for 10: the late-payment penalty and interest figures for LLCs/LPs/GPs are not in the evidence, and nothing independent or hands-on corroborates these first-party figures.
